description: Follow a hypermedia link from the current representation with its required free parameters.

plan_id.description: Identifier of the target plan scope, or the literal NO_PLAN for the project's workspace scope, or for the machine scope where the worker's task is of the machine scope (resolved from the job record). Exactly one of plan_id or epic_id is required (server-enforced).

epic_id.description: Identifier of the target epic scope. Mutually exclusive with plan_id.

entity.description: Optional entity identifier: the task entity whose link is followed, as its offer names it (a worker may name only an entity offered to it, server-enforced); with plan_id NO_PLAN also an entry_id its offer names.

link.description: Link identifier from the current representation (e.g., 'ack', 'submit:TASK-003', 'consult:triage-review', 'ask').

args.description: Free parameters required by the target link, validated server-side against the link's closed parameter schema.
